verdict.rationale: This is the reference OpenAI API. The docs ship the official SDKs (npm `openai`, openai-python) and support any HTTP client. Chat Completions remains supported alongside Responses, and a migrate-to-responses guide exists, so existing OpenAI-compatible tooling keeps working against the platform. Missing for 10: no documented migration or adapter path from other providers' SDKs, and no independent hands-on confirmation that third-party OpenAI-compatible tools work unchanged.
